data.title: 椎名真白 · 雨中撑伞的猫步
data.description: 放学小雨，她撑着伞沿着白线一步一步走猫步，积水溅起也不管；伞沿压得很低，只露出没有表情的半张脸，画面安静而奇妙。
data.action: 压低雨伞，沿白线一步接一步地轻巧前行。
data.promptProse: Mashiro Shiina follows the painted white road line one step at a time in the after-school drizzle, umbrella lowered until only half of her expressionless face shows. Her navy blazer, red ribbon and knee-length skirt remain visible as puddles splash beside her shoes. The medium portrait follows the stripe into the wet street. Overcast light spreads softly over the canopy and paving, with reflected grey sky brighter than the shadow directly beneath her.
